doc: Market layer — machine-readable mirror of world/market.md (canonical). Job churn, hiring channels, skill ladders, seasonal rhythm, housing vacancy lifecycle, word-of-mouth room channel, off-registry ambient ring, move-in math. Money is game dollars; no credit figures in this layer (deed fees live in housing.json only). Conditions, not scripts. Internal tier — spectator surfaces get texture, never this machinery.

ambient_ring.spec: 20 ambients live one ring out — rooming-house floors, in-law units, family duplexes, 90s rent-controlled one-bedrooms
ambient_ring.mint_rule: promotion mints a real 9xxx address per address-spec §6 (landlord-as-clerk) + a lease row; ambients.md home-base note becomes registry truth
ambient_ring.why_off_registry: enumerating 20 addresses invites treating ambients' homes as stages — the ring is texture until promotion

move_in_math.vs: 66% of a part-time baseline month — the day-one door
~1 month's barista gross — needs savings or a mid job

pacing_note: moving is the expensive part, not the rent — room→studio ≈ 3–5 months of play at baseline wages (intended)
